```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(ldatuning)
library(topicmodels)
library(LDAvis)
library(tm)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Data Preparation

```{r}
df <- read.csv("../data/data_advice_fulltext.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
```

## Preprocessing

```{r}
raw_text_df <- tibble(
  doc_id = df$ID,
  gen = as.factor(df$gen),
  text = df$text
)

# unigram
tidy_text_df <- raw_text_df %>%
  unnest_tokens(
    word,
    text,
    token = "regex",
    pattern = "\\s+|[[:punct:]+\\-><]" # remove punctuation
  ) %>%
  filter(nchar(word) > 2)

# bigram
bigrams_df <- raw_text_df %>%
  unnest_tokens(
    bigram,
    text,
    token = "ngrams",
    n = 2
  )

# combine bigram & unigram
combined_df <- bind_rows(
  tidy_text_df %>% mutate(term = word),
  bigrams_df %>% mutate(term = bigram)
)

# count occurences & remove stopwords
word_counts <- combined_df %>%
  anti_join(get_stopwords(language = "en", source = "snowball"), by = c("term" = "word")) %>%
  count(doc_id, word, sort = TRUE)

# document freq
doc_freq <- word_counts %>%
  group_by(word) %>%
  summarize(doc_count = n_distinct(doc_id))

# parameters
no_below <- 10   # Minimum number of documents a term must appear in
no_above <- 0.5 # Maximum proportion of documents a term can appear in

# filter using parameters
total_docs <- n_distinct(tidy_text_df$doc_id)

filtered_words <- doc_freq %>%
  filter(doc_count >= no_below & doc_count <= (no_above*total_docs))

# filter original word count
word_counts <- word_counts %>%
  filter(word %in% filtered_words$word)

# create Document-Term Matrix
dtm <- word_counts %>%
  cast_dtm(doc_id, word, n)

dtm
```

## LDA Model

```{r}
alpha_values <- c(0.1, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 50)

lda_models <- lapply(alpha_values, function(a) {
  LDA(dtm,
    k = 5,
    control = list(
      alpha = a,
      estimate.alpha = FALSE,
      seed = 37
    )
  )
})

perplexities <- sapply(lda_models, perplexity, newdata = dtm)

results <- data.frame(alpha = alpha_values, perplexity = perplexities)
print(results)
```


## TEST

```{r}
library(topicmodels)
library(tidytext)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Assuming 'dtm' is your preprocessed document-term matrix

# Function to calculate perplexity
calc_perplexity <- function(model, test_data) {
  perplexity(model, newdata = test_data)
}

# Function to calculate coherence (simplified version)
calc_coherence <- function(model, dtm) {
  topics <- tidy(model, matrix = "beta")
  top_terms <- topics %>%
    group_by(topic) %>%
    top_n(10, beta) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Calculate pairwise PMI for top terms (simplified)
  mean(top_terms$beta)
}

# Function to calculate topic diversity (simplified)
calc_diversity <- function(model) {
  topics <- tidy(model, matrix = "beta")
  unique_words <- topics %>%
    group_by(topic) %>%
    top_n(10, beta) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    distinct(term) %>%
    nrow()
  
  unique_words / (10 * max(topics$topic))
}

# Assuming 'dtm' is your document-term matrix
set.seed(123)  # for reproducibility
shuffled_indices <- sample(1:nrow(dtm))
dtm_shuffled <- dtm[shuffled_indices, ]

# Now split into train and test
train_size <- floor(0.8 * nrow(dtm_shuffled))
dtm_train <- dtm_shuffled[1:train_size, ]
dtm_test <- dtm_shuffled[(train_size+1):nrow(dtm_shuffled), ]

# Parameters to test
k_values <- c(4, 5, 6, 7, 10)
alpha_values <- c(0.1, 0.5, 1)
beta_values <- c(0.1, 0.5, 1)

results <- expand.grid(k = k_values, alpha = alpha_values, beta = beta_values)
results$perplexity <- NA
results$coherence <- NA
results$diversity <- NA

# Run models and collect metrics
for (i in 1:nrow(results)) {
  k <- results$k[i]
  alpha <- results$alpha[i]
  beta <- results$beta[i]
  
  model <- LDA(dtm_train, k = k, method = "Gibbs", 
               control = list(alpha = alpha, delta = beta, seed = 1234))
  
  results$perplexity[i] <- calc_perplexity(model, dtm_test)
  results$coherence[i] <- calc_coherence(model, dtm_train)
  results$diversity[i] <- calc_diversity(model)
  
  cat("Completed model", i, "of", nrow(results), "\n")
}

# Visualize results
ggplot(results, aes(x = k, y = perplexity, color = factor(alpha), linetype = factor(beta))) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Perplexity by Number of Topics",
       x = "Number of Topics (k)",
       y = "Perplexity",
       color = "Alpha",
       linetype = "Beta")

ggplot(results, aes(x = k, y = coherence, color = factor(alpha), linetype = factor(beta))) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Coherence by Number of Topics",
       x = "Number of Topics (k)",
       y = "Coherence",
       color = "Alpha",
       linetype = "Beta")

ggplot(results, aes(x = k, y = diversity, color = factor(alpha), linetype = factor(beta))) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Diversity by Number of Topics",
       x = "Number of Topics (k)",
       y = "Diversity",
       color = "Alpha",
       linetype = "Beta")

# Find optimal model
optimal_model <- results %>%
  arrange(perplexity) %>%
  slice(1)

cat("Optimal model parameters:\n",
    "k =", optimal_model$k, "\n",
    "alpha =", optimal_model$alpha, "\n",
    "beta =", optimal_model$beta, "\n",
    "Perplexity =", optimal_model$perplexity, "\n",
    "Coherence =", optimal_model$coherence, "\n",
    "Diversity =", optimal_model$diversity, "\n")

```




```{r}
library(ldatuning)
library(utils)

# Create a list to store results
results_list <- list()
nrun = 20
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrun, style = 3)

# Loop through 10 different seeds
for (i in 1:nrun) {
  set.seed(i)
  result <- FindTopicsNumber(
    dtm,  # Your document-term matrix
    topics = seq(2, 20, by = 1),  # Range of k values to test
    metrics = c("Griffiths2004", "CaoJuan2009", "Arun2010", "Deveaud2014"),
    method = "Gibbs",
    mc.cores = 4L,  # Use multiple cores for faster computation
    verbose = TRUE
  )
  
  # Store the result in the list
  results_list[[i]] <- result
  
  # Generate and save the plot
  plot <- FindTopicsNumber_plot(result)
  ggsave(paste0("topic_number_plot_seed_", i, ".png"), plot, width = 10, height = 8)
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
}
```


```{r}
results_list
run = 1
df_result <- tibble()
for (i in results_list){
  i <- i %>% mutate("run" = run)
  df_result <- bind_rows(df_result, i)
  run <- run + 1
}

df_result <- df_result %>%
  group_by(topics) %>%
  summarize(
    Griffiths2004 = mean(Griffiths2004),
    CaoJuan2009 = mean(CaoJuan2009),
    Arun2010 = mean(Arun2010),
    Deveaud2014 = mean(Deveaud2014)
  )

plot <- FindTopicsNumber_plot(df_result)
```


```{r}
k <- 5

lda_model <- LDA(dtm, k = k, method = "Gibbs")
print(lda_model)

# Extract top terms for each topic
top_terms <- terms(lda_model, 10)
print(top_terms)
```

```{r}
posterior_distribution = posterior(lda_model)
document_topic_probs <- posterior_distribution$topics
```


```{r}
topic_prob_doc <- tidy(lda_model, matrix = "gamma") %>%
  rename("ID" = "document") %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  filter(gamma == max(gamma))
```


```{r}
df <- read.csv("../../output/processed/data_stake.csv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)

df_topic <- left_join(df, topic_prob_doc %>% select(-gamma), by = "ID")
```


```{r}
df_graph <- df_topic %>%
  group_by(gen) %>%
  filter(!is.na(topic)) %>%
  count(topic)

ggplot(df_graph, aes(x = as.factor(gen), y = n, color = as.factor(topic))) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_discrete(name = "Topic") +
  labs(x = "Generation", y = "# documents") +
  theme_minimal()
  
```


```{r}
df_stat <- tidy(lda_model, matrix = "gamma") %>%
  rename("ID" = "document") %>%
  mutate(topic = paste0("topic_", topic)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = ID,
    names_from = topic,
    values_from = gamma
  )


df_stat <- left_join(df, df_stat, by = "ID")
```



```{r}
cor.test(df_stat$score_corrected, df_stat$topic_5)
cor.test(df_stat$score_corrected, df_stat$topic_1)
```

theta <- posterior(lda_model)$topics
doc.length <- rowSums(lda_model@documents)
vocab <- colnames(lda_model@beta)
term.frequency <- colSums(lda_model@documents)
